declared_and_pinned_differences: Non-scalar UTF-16 surrogates reject strictly by default; explicit opt-in non_scalar_text='lossy-replacement' matches DexSQL U+FFFD replacement on plain UTF-8 columns while emitting non-blocking diagnostics.
COUNT(*) ordering, original MUTF-8 preservation in text values, and trailing backslash escaping in LIKE follow frozen MDD-035/MDD-070 declared conventions.
TEMP catalog redefinition before compatible offset paging fails closed with SOURCE_CHANGED instead of silently stitching two TEMP definitions.
Desktop workbench diff compares definitions without instruction operands and uses Chinese UI copy.

open_fail_closed_gaps.detail: Q16 named_temp_queries matches A0 in scenario tests (MDD-033), but dexsql-0.1.0/0.1.1 full compatibility lacks a labelled Q16 HostLab corpus.
GLOB and recursive CTEs fail closed (BINARY_OPERATOR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED / RECURSIVE_CTE_NOT_YET_QUALIFIED).
SQLite DQS unknown double-quoted identifiers are rejected instead of coerced to string literals.

excluded_optional_capabilities.mdd_075_optional_local_analysis: Optional method-local CFG/def-use only; whole-program call graphs/taint not claimed.
a2_dexsql_011_mcp_compact: DexSQL 0.1.1 MCP query refuses offset+limit > 100000 (verified directly on real binary), whereas hostlab-9161100 classes has 310,716 rows, hostlab-9170100 has 345,907 rows, and method_calls exceeds 1,000,000 rows.

MCP open_dataset/query does not expose an immutable snapshot_id/source SHA-256 generation binding proof or deterministic tie-breaking outer ORDER BY rewrite guarantee for HostLab arbitrary projections.
Original HostLab native_audit consumes CLI query --interactive (which has no compact switch) + shape/hex/sentinel marker; no 20-group qualified MCP audit consumer is deployed in HostLab.

columns_v1_ipc.rationale: Direct streaming UTF-8 JSON framing (BatchStreamEncoder + B1Session._decode_direct_batches) already delivers >=15% W05 speedup over A1 while speaking standard JSON Lines consumed directly by the Python SDK/workbench without a custom binary wire negotiation split; columns-v1 remains cleanly isolated and unit-tested as an opt-in IPC building block.

residual_notes: Joint Windows JobObject peak commit on 33-DEX W07-hostlab-9161100 reaches 1.214 GiB (probe) / 1.215 GiB (median), cutting pre-opt parallel 2.31 GiB by -47.4% and beating A1 (1.493 GiB) and MDD-060 unoptimized B1 (1.28 GiB), while remaining above the <1.0 GiB stretch target.

HostLab production APKs (hostlab-9161100, hostlab-9170100) are Windows-local private inputs; cross-platform byte parity between Windows x86_64 and Linux x86_64 is proved on all 5 standard public workloads (MDD-080) with HostLab live shadow audits executed on Windows x86_64.
Repository qualification under MDD-082 does not execute or authorize external production cutover or deployment.
